seoDescription: Join Shruti Turner for a small-group movement and wellbeing retreat near Stirling, Scotland. A weekend of yoga, mobility, strength-based movement, nature, reflection and rest.
fullDescription:
Join me for a weekend at Powis House, Stirling, designed to help you step away from everyday life, slow down and reconnect with yourself.

It is a chance to create space, to move your body, spend time outdoors, enjoy nourishing food and rest in a beautiful setting. This is not a weekend about achieving more, doing everything perfectly or pushing yourself. 

Across the weekend, we will explore movement through yoga, mobility and strength-based practices, with options throughout so you can choose what feels right for your body.

There will also be opportunities to walk, enjoy the grounds, take a cold dip, relax in the hot tub, read, chat, reflect or simply do less for a while.

The weekend is intentionally small, with a maximum of 10 participants, creating a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere where you can take what you need from the experience.

Everything is optional. You are invited to follow the rhythm of the weekend while making choices that support you.
scheduleMarkdown:
## Friday — Unwind

- Arrive from 3pm and settle into Powis House
- Welcome gathering and gentle opening practice
- Relaxed homemade dinner together
- Yoga nidra, meditation and deep rest


## Saturday — Explore

- Optional outdoor movement: easy run, gentle walk or slow morning
- Morning movement practice combining yoga, mobility and strength-based movement
- Slow brunch with plenty of options
- Spacious afternoon to explore the grounds, walk, cold dip, enjoy the hot tub, read, rest or explore Stirling
- Optional 1:1 session with Shruti (limited availability)
- Slow down: gentle movement, breath and relaxation
- Outdoor pizza night (weather permitting)


## Sunday — Return

- Slow breakfast and time to pack
- Closing movement practice and reflection
- Final goodbyes before 11am checkout
shortDescription: A relaxed weekend of movement, good food, time outside and plenty of space to do less. Move when you want to, rest when you need to, and enjoy a few days away from the usual pace of life.
audienceDescription: For anyone craving a few days away from the usual pace of life, with space to move, be outside, eat well, rest and simply see what they feel like doing. No yoga or fitness experience needed.
atmosphereDescription: Relaxed, welcoming and spacious. Expect a balance of movement, nature, conversation and rest, with everything optional and no pressure to do it all.
foodAndDrinkDescription:
Food is part of the experience: relaxed, nourishing meals designed to be shared together.

The weekend will include homemade dinners, slow brunches, snacks, fruit, tea and coffee throughout the day.

Meals will be simple, welcoming and flexible, with options available to suit different dietary needs. Dietary requirements will be collected after booking.
accommodationDescription:
Guests will stay across two restored Georgian cottages at Powis House, creating a comfortable and relaxed base for the weekend.

The cottages provide shared spaces for meals, conversations and downtime, while our dedicated movement space allows the weekend to flow naturally between activity, connection and rest.

A range of shared and private room options are available, allowing you to choose the type of accommodation that works best for you.
